name: motionboard
description: Make product launch videos, promo videos and motion graphics in code with HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP rendered to MP4), from 58 shot recipes taken from Apple, Linear, Figma and other launch films. Use when the user asks to make a launch video, product video, promo or app trailer, including from just a product URL or repo in one command; asks for a specific effect such as a match cut transition, logo reveal or logo animation, text scramble, kinetic typography, typing / typewriter animation, word-by-
author: krisyangdev
